resources.string: Keep what matters. Clear the rest.
Junk you won\'t miss, cleaned in one tap. Everything waits 30 days in the trash.
Things that might matter, explained in plain words. You decide.
Your memories go to your own drive and are checked before anything is deleted.
No ads. No tracking. No internet access.
To look at your photos, videos and files, KeepClear needs your permission. Everything stays on this phone.
To find screenshots, big videos and what can be backed up.
Nothing leaves your phone unless you move it to a drive you choose.
Without it: only junk and app caches.
Finds WhatsApp media, folders left from your old phone, and other apps\' recycle bins.
Android still keeps other apps\' private data closed. KeepClear never deletes anything without asking you.
Without it: photos, videos and audio only.
Optional. Lets KeepClear find WhatsApp media, old-phone folders and recycle bins.
KeepClear sees only the photos you picked. Allow all to get real numbers.
Seeing photos, videos and audio only.
Scan stopped because access was removed. These numbers are incomplete.
Your phone is almost full. KeepClear is using as little space as possible.
Less than 100 MB left. KeepClear isn\'t saving anything until there\'s more room.
Junk you won\'t miss. Everything waits 30 days in the trash.
Screenshots, big videos, old-phone folders. You decide.
Photos and videos to back up, check, then free.
Backing up arrives in a later version
A favourite or recently changed, so it needs your review.
%1$s · space returns as items expire, or empty now.
%1$s. This can\'t be undone. Items with a checked copy on a drive are still safe there; the rest has no other copy.
A checked copy is on %1$s. The file on the phone is deleted permanently.
%1$s. They\'ll wait in KeepClear\'s trash for 30 days, so you can restore anything.
Space returns when the trash empties, or empty it now.
%1$s changed since the scan, so we left them alone.
Android deletes temporary app data that apps rebuild on their own.
Cleared by Android. This can\'t be restored, and apps rebuild it as needed. Nothing goes to KeepClear\'s trash.
They\'ll wait in the trash for 30 days. Tap ✕ to keep any of them.
KeepClear can\'t see what\'s in Google Photos. If you use it, check there, or use its own “Free up space”.
This is a cloud folder. KeepClear can copy to it but can\'t check the copy, so the originals stay on the phone.
KeepClear reads every copy back to check it. Some apps show a copy before it\'s really saved, so if this is a cloud app, keep the originals.
Not enough space on the drive: %1$s needed, %2$s free.
%1$s are larger than 4 GB and can\'t go on this drive. They stay on the phone.
%1$s are larger than 4 GB. KeepClear can\'t tell whether this drive can hold files that big, so to be safe they stay on the phone.
Battery is below 20 percent. Connect the charger to start.
%1$s get a slightly different name so the drive accepts them. The manifest lists the original names.
This place can\'t be read back, so the originals stay on the phone.
This folder is on the phone itself. Pick a USB drive or an SD card.
This folder has a .keepclear-target file that KeepClear didn\'t write. Pick another folder.
KeepClear was closed while you were choosing the drive, so the selection was lost. Select what to move again.
KeepClear can\'t open this drive. Check that it\'s plugged in and try again.
Paused: the drive was disconnected. Plug it in and tap Continue.
Paused: KeepClear lost access to the drive. Choose it again.
Paused: the phone is almost full.
Stopped. Files already checked stay on the drive.
Paused by Android\'s time limit for long tasks. Tap Continue.
Paused because KeepClear was closed or updated. Tap Continue.
A different drive is connected. Plug in %1$s.
%1$s copied and checked (read back from the drive, SHA-256).
%1$s were gone from the phone and were skipped.
%1$s couldn\'t be read on the phone and were skipped.
%1$s are larger than 4 GB and stay on the phone.
%1$s didn\'t match after copying, three times. They stay on the phone.
%1$s couldn\'t be written to the drive.
%1$s were copied but can\'t be checked on this place, so they stay on the phone too.
%1$s changed while copying and were skipped.
%1$s got a different name on the drive (listed in the manifest).
Your files are on %1$s in %2$s. To bring them back, open them with any file manager or computer. In-app restore is coming.
On a computer, check them with: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
The copy on the drive is not encrypted. Anyone with the drive can open it.
The originals stay on the phone: this place can\'t be checked.
%1$s will move to KeepClear\'s trash. Each one is checked against its copy on the drive first. You can restore them for 30 days.
%1$s moved to the trash. Skipped: %2$s (changed, or copy missing). Failed: %3$s.
Notifications are off, so you won\'t see progress outside KeepClear.
So you can see backup progress and get told when it\'s done or needs you.
Backup paused. Open KeepClear to continue.
Backup paused by an app update. Tap to continue.

KeepClear backup receipt
Drive: %1$s
Folder: %2$s
Files checked with SHA-256: %3$d (%4$s)
Files skipped or not copied: %5$d
Check on a computer: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
The copy is not encrypted.
